seo.title: Coming soon | Awrea Paris
seo.description: The next Awrea Paris collection: its name, its unveiling date, its first images. Subscribers to the Maison’s letter can order its pieces in preview.
seo.privee: A private presentation by Awrea Paris, opened with the password the Maison has given you.

attente.chapeau: The next collection is being prepared in the atelier, between lace and draping. Subscribers to the Maison’s letter see it before anyone else and order its pieces in preview.

boutique.texte: The Hypnotic Lace collection can be ordered today. Each piece is made to order by French artisans, once your order is placed.
boutique.label: See the pieces

inscription.texte: Subscribers to the Maison’s letter receive a personal link by email. From {avantPremiere}, it opens the collection to them before anyone else: they order its pieces before the unveiling, and each one is made for them, to order, by French artisans. Leave your address to receive this link.
inscription.texteEnCours: The preview is open until {devoilement}. Leave your address: a personal link reaches you straight away by email, and you can order its pieces before the unveiling to all. Each one is made for you, to order, by French artisans.
inscription.merci: Noted. Your personal link has just been sent by email. Open it on the phone or computer you will order from.
inscription.mention: Your address is used only to send you this link and to write to you about this preview.

privee.texte: This collection is first shown to a few people. The Maison has given you the password: it opens the presentation in this browser, with its images and its pieces.

ouverte.titre: The private presentation is open to you
ouverte.texte: From this browser, its pieces can be ordered now, before the unveiling to all on {devoilement}. Each one is made for you, to order, by French artisans.

pret.texte: It is saved in this browser. The pieces below can be ordered here from {avantPremiere}, before the unveiling to all on {devoilement}.

ouvert.texte: From this browser, the pieces below can be ordered now, before the unveiling to all on {devoilement}. Each one is made for you, to order, by French artisans.

devoilee.texte: Its pieces can be ordered in the shop. Each one is made to order by French artisans, once your order is placed.
devoilee.label: Order a piece

lienInvalide: This link is no longer valid. Leave your address again: a new link will reach you straight away.

erreurs.limite: Several attempts in a short time: please try again in a few minutes.
erreurs.close: This preview is no longer accepting sign-ups. The pieces of the collection can be ordered in the shop.
erreurs.motDePasse: Please enter the password given by the Maison.
erreurs.refuse: This password does not open this private presentation.
erreurs.generale: The request did not go through. Please try again.

porte.annonce: This piece belongs to the next collection, {collection}. Subscribers to the Maison’s letter can order it in preview from {avantPremiere}, then everyone from {devoilement}.
porte.avantPremiere: This piece can currently be ordered in preview, with the personal link sent to subscribers to the Maison’s letter. It opens to all on {devoilement}.
porte.privee: This piece belongs to the private presentation of the {collection} collection. It can be ordered with the password given by the Maison, then opens to all on {devoilement}.

refus.annonce: The {collection} collection is not open yet. Subscribers to the Maison’s letter can order it in preview from {avantPremiere}.
refus.avantPremiere: The {collection} collection can be ordered in preview until {devoilement}, with the personal link sent by email to subscribers to the letter.
refus.privee: The {collection} collection can be ordered with the private presentation password until {devoilement}.

inscription.objet: The {collection} collection, your link to the preview
inscription.preheader: Your personal link to order the {collection} collection before anyone else.
paragraphes: You are signed up for the preview of the {collection} collection. It opens to you from {avantPremiere}, before the unveiling to all on {devoilement}.
This link is personal. Open it on the phone or computer you will order from: it keeps your access there.
Each piece is made to order by French artisans, once your order is placed.
inscription.signature:
With our full attention,
Maison Awrea Paris

lettre.preheader: Your personal link to order the {collection} collection before anyone else.
paragraphes: A new collection is being prepared in the atelier: {collection}. It will be unveiled to all on {devoilement}.

As a subscriber to the Maison’s letter, you see it before anyone else. From {avantPremiere}, this personal link lets you order its pieces in preview. Open it on the phone or computer you will order from.
Each piece is made to order by French artisans, once your order is placed.
lettre.signature:
With our full attention,
Maison Awrea Paris
lettre.note: You are receiving this email because you subscribe to the Maison’s letter. To stop receiving it, one click is enough: {desinscription}

atelier.chapeau: Announce the next collection on the “Coming soon” page: its name, its unveiling date, a text and images. Subscribers to the letter order it in preview, before it opens to all. A private presentation remains reserved, until the unveiling, for the people who have the password.

liste.vide: No collection announced. The “Coming soon” page invites visitors to subscribe to the Maison’s letter.

formulaire.adresse: Page address (lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens)
formulaire.texteAide: A blank line separates two paragraphs.
formulaire.images: Images (one address per line, for example /media/img/odessa-1)
formulaire.imagesAide: Without an image, the photographs of the chosen pieces are shown.
formulaire.piecesAide: They leave the shop until the unveiling and can be ordered in preview.
formulaire.lettre: Write to subscribers to the Maison’s letter: each one receives her personal link to the preview, only once for this collection
formulaire.privee: Private presentation: until the unveiling, the collection is reserved for the people who have the password
formulaire.nouveauMotDePasse: New password (leave empty to keep the current one)
